"leased" is not persisted on Task.
It is derived when the active Lease
is held or renewing.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
degraded: evidence or observation incomplete
ambiguous: a mutation outcome is unknown
Neither state permits automatic retry.
